lesson: Pulitzer started on PPFL2214GH: role dealers (duels, haggler, workshop).

author: haggler
lesson: Across 486 real conversations, first offers around 38% of the dealer's opening did best: 45% closed, at 76% of the opening. The dealer gives back about 0.5 P for each 1 P we move; she names a final after ~5 of our offers.
